reports.title: Farm Pond Crappie
reports.text:
Small farm ponds can produce big crappie with proper management.
Farm Pond Crappie
By Brent Frazee
Photos courtesy of Jason Harris
You won’t find Jason Harris’ favorite crappie-fishing spot on the Kansas state map.
He fishes reservoirs such as Council Grove, Melvern and Pomona, especially in the winter. But when he wants to catch a big fish, he walks out his back door and heads to a small farm pond on the land he and his wife Angela own.
Get this. He meticulously measures the black crappie he and his family catch, and they average 14 inches in length.
“We don’t catch numbers of fish that big at the reservoirs I fish,” said Harris, 47.
So, what’s his secret for success? He manages his ponds…
